raw.details:
About the Hackathon

  • Welcome to the Hack 2 Ignite 2026-27, a hackathon where innovation meets technology to solve real-world challenges. This hackathon brings together talented students, developers, designers, and innovators from across the country to collaborate, build impactful solutions, and transform ideas into working prototypes.
  • Participants will work on industry-relevant problem statements across diverse domains, including Artificial Intelligence, FinTech, Agriculture, Healthcare, EduTech, Game Development, Web3 & Blockchain, and Environment & Sustainable Development. The event aims to encourage innovation, critical thinking, teamwork, and entrepreneurship while providing participants with an opportunity to showcase their technical and problem-solving skills.
  • The hackathon will be conducted in a multi-stage format, beginning with an online qualification round, where teams will develop and submit their prototype and presentation. Based on the evaluation, the Top 30 teams will be shortlisted and invited to the on-campus Grand Finale, where they will present their solutions before an expert panel of judges.

Whether you're an aspiring entrepreneur, AI enthusiast, software developer, UI/UX designer, or problem solver, this hackathon offers an excellent opportunity to:

  • Solve real-world challenges.
  • Collaborate with talented peers.
  • Receive guidance from mentors and industry experts.
  • Showcase innovative ideas and technical expertise.
  • Network with professionals, startups, and recruiters.
  • Compete for exciting cash prizes, certificates, and recognition.

If you're passionate about building technology that creates real impact, this is your chance to turn your ideas into reality.

Themes

Participants can choose problem statements from the following domains:

  • FinTech
  • Agriculture
  • EduTech
  • Healthcare
  • Game Development
  • Environment & Sustainable Development
  • ️ Web3 & Blockchain
  • AI for Good

Please Read All Rules regarding hackathon here: https://tinyurl.com/hack2ignite-rulebook
Please Join Whatsapp Channel for latest updates: https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029Vb8bQv32ER6ZOvbqH92v

Event Format

Round 0: Registration

  • Open registrations through Unstop.
  • Teams can register during the registration window.

Round 1: Online Qualifier (48 Hours)

  • Registered teams will receive the problem statements.
  • Teams must develop a prototype and prepare a presentation (PPT).
  • The prototype must be built within the 48 hour window, github history will be checked.
  • Submissions will be evaluated by the judging panel.

Round 2: Grand Finale (On-Campus)

  • The Top 30 shortlisted teams will be invited to the college.
  • A ₹500 participation fee per team will be applicable for teams shortlisted for the Grand Finale.
  • Teams will work on existing prototype improve it or add new feature, present their prototype and pitch their solution before an expert jury.
  • Winners will be selected based on innovation, technical implementation, presentation, feasibility, and impact.

Who Can Participate?

  • Undergraduate students (B.Tech, BE, BCA, B.Sc., BBA, Design, and related programs)
  • Postgraduate students (M.Tech, MCA, M.Sc., MBA, and related programs)
  • Student developers, innovators, startup enthusiasts, and technology enthusiasts across India.
  • Inter college teams are allowed.

Prize Pool

Total Prize Pool: ₹1,50,000

  • 1st Prize – ₹70,000
  • 2nd Prize – ₹50,000
  • 3rd Prize – ₹30,000

Along with cash prizes, participants will receive certificates, networking opportunities, and exposure to industry professionals.

Why Participate?

  • Work on real-world industry challenges.
  • Build an impressive portfolio project.
  • Gain mentorship from experts.
  • Showcase your skills before an experienced jury.
  • Connect with innovators from across the country.
  • Win exciting cash prizes and certificates.
  • Explore internship, startup, and networking opportunities.
